profile.summary: Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the property development business in Malaysia. It operates through Housing development and Other business segments. The company develops and constructs residential and commercial properties. It is also involved in the property management; building construction; general trading and management; and healthcare related activities, as well as operates as a general contractor. The company was formerly known as Sinmah Capital Berhad and changed its name to Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad in January 2026. Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
profile.zh: Rivertree STF Synergies Berhad 是一家投资控股公司，在马来西亚从事房地产开发业务，前身为 Sinmah Capital Berhad，于2026年1月更名，1994年成立，总部位于吉隆坡。
lines: 住宅与商业房地产开发：开发并建设住宅及商业物业，面向购房者和商业物业买家。
物业管理：提供物业管理服务。
建筑施工与总承包：承接建筑施工业务并作为总承包商运营。
一般贸易与管理：从事一般贸易及管理相关业务。
医疗保健相关业务：参与医疗保健相关活动。
lines_en: Residential and commercial property development: develops and constructs residential and commercial properties for homebuyers and commercial property buyers.
Property management: provides property management services.
Building construction and general contracting: undertakes building construction and operates as a general contractor.
General trading and management: engages in general trading and management activities.
Healthcare-related activities: involved in healthcare-related activities.
